documents.route: unknown (letter to a 'Herr Gevatter', signature not read)

plaintext.source: Words of the time written over most cipher words; not transcribed yet.

documents.shelfmark: Hessisches Staatsarchiv Darmstadt, D 4 Nr. 113/9, fol. 5r (image 03)

system.summary: Fol. 17: letters replaced by two-digit numbers (10-39) and a few single digits, homophones for t (8+, 32) and m (22, 24), one code sign (probably Landgraf Johann). Fols. 2 and 5: a different system of letters, digits and signs, not yet identified.

prior_solution.where: No decipherment known: catalogue check of 26 Oct 2026 and web search of 14 Nov 2026; the writer's margin notes on fol. 17 paraphrase the blocks.

conditions.human_role: Arya Sanketbhai Patel ran the session. An AI agent found the image route, transcribed, rebuilt the key and read fol. 17. No palaeographer checked the transcription.
models: AI coding agent (model not named by the contributor)

solution.what: Repository, PRs, issues and web searched: no decipherment of these letters; hatzfeldt1641 is another target.

Archivportal-D behind an Anubis bot check (not bypassed); DDB API EDM record lists the scans on digitalisate-he.arcinsys.de; D 4 113/9 (18 images), 141/2, 239/1 reached; the other 16 files not digitised.
Fol. 17, two cipher blocks, 216 number groups (c_f17.txt).
Margin summary '... und erheblichen ...' against line 17.1.4 '34 23 17 12 28 16 12 11 13 14 5 16 12 23': one-for-one substitution; key rebuilt from the letter (key_f17.json), every group decodes.
Fol. 17 read: 39 words read, 2 holes (code sign), read share 0.951; translation (reading_f17.md).
Filed key D 4 141/2 (1652-58 symbol alphabets) compared with fol. 17: a different system.
Fols. 2/5 symbol cipher against the interlinear words: 'die convoy von' fits one letter table, 'Landgraff Johann' does not as read; left open. Lead: Landgrave Johann's 'Chiffrentabelle' (web search).

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: The fol. 17 key was rebuilt from the letter with the writer's own margin summaries on the same page as cribs.
outcome.notes: Status in progress. Fol. 17 (18 Nov 1643) read, 0.951. Fols. 2 and 5 (symbol cipher with words of the time over it) open and workable; the other 16 files of catalogue 568 are not digitised.

credits.note: Image route found (DDB API -> digitalisate-he.arcinsys.de); D 4 113/9 fol. 17 transcribed, key rebuilt from the margin notes, read; targets/georg1643/

texts.label: D 4 113/9 fol. 17, Giessen councillors to Georg II, 18 Nov 1643: two-digit cipher, key rebuilt from the margin notes
texts.summary: The councillors at Giessen report that the Landgrave's brother is to hurry back to Darmstadt to confer with Georg II in person on weighty points, and that he will arrive there on Monday evening.
texts.note: 39 words read, the code sign (probably Landgraf Johann) open.
